description: Programmatic comparison of both error-code tables gives 566 codes on Capella and 565 on Server, with exactly one code present only on Capella: 2505, 'Workload reporting is not supported in Community Edition. It is an enterprise level feature.' This is backwards. Capella has no Community Edition, so the row is meaningless there; Server is the product that actually has the CE/EE split and is the page where a reader could hit the error.
